description.value:
As an Action, you may radiate a 10 foot radius of Stamina draining energy. This radius increases by 10 feet each time your Proficiency Bonus increases. This Feature requires concentration to maintain and cost at least 20 Ki.

Whenever a creature enters this space or begin/ends it's turn in the radius you absorb 1 Stamina per 20 ki spent to maintain this feature.

All Stamina gained in this way over your maximum becomes Temporary Stamina.
